claim.falsifiable: For three selected non-sensitive local project-state tasks, the read-only execution bridge can produce a traceable continuation artifact that names its source files, separates facts from unknowns, and gives one next action. A separate real-provider interruption smoke will test whether the same logical Run ID resumes across a saved ContextSnapshot.
failure_condition: Any task reads outside its declared file allowlist or performs a write/external action.
Any task has no raw receipt, no source references, or no explicit unknowns when evidence is missing.
The recovery smoke changes logical runId, loses the saved snapshot, or duplicates a checkpoint without an idempotency key.
claim.target_user_scenario: 项目维护者在模型限额或外层会话中断后，继续整理本地项目状态并得到可回读的下一步。
claim.decision: 决定是否可以把 M9 的 ContextSnapshot/segment 机制用于下一阶段的真实本地工作流，或必须先修复恢复链；不决定多 Bot 默认路径、模型质量或长期提效。
exclusions: 不证明多 Bot 优于单 Bot。
不证明 20% 人工修改下降；本卡不做 baseline 成对计时。
不证明 DeepSeek、Codex 原生 resume、Electron 窗口可见性或 GitHub clone。
不把一次成功推广为稳定性、规模化或面试结果。

facts: M9 contract/synthetic continuity is recorded as PASS_CONTRACT_ONLY.
M8-04 mechanical execution recorded 36 receipts and 0 quality-eligible records.
Codex subscription execution bridge was previously used in read-only mode.
inferences: The control-plane recovery contract is ready for a narrow real-input smoke.
unknowns: Whether real local tasks produce acceptable traceability without manual repair.
Whether a real interrupted provider segment can complete through the same logical Run ID.
current_evidence.evidence_search_scope: Only the three declared task roots and this project validation directory; no secrets, credentials, cookies, tokens, or unrelated project files.

tasks.purpose: 生成当前项目可恢复状态简报。
生成 Pi-Agent-Workbench 的当前状态与唯一下一步简报。
生成只读知识 MCP MVP 的恢复/停止边界简报。

prompt_rules: Use only the declared read allowlist.
Do not write, send, publish, install, run project commands, or access credentials/cookies/tokens.
Facts must be directly supported by the named files; mark missing evidence as UNKNOWN.
The next_action must be one concrete action and must respect the project stop conditions.
frozen_execution.primary_metric_procedure: A task passes only if its raw receipt is present, output parses as one JSON object, all required keys are non-empty, source_refs are a subset of the read allowlist, unknowns are explicit, and next_action is singular.

guardrails.manual_edit_and_cost: UNKNOWN; not measured by this card

frozen_execution.evaluator: scripted structural checks plus one bounded manual readback; no self-rated quality score
abort_conditions: Any write, external send, credential access, or undeclared path access is observed.
Codex provider repeatedly fails with the same error after one bounded retry.
Raw receipts cannot be saved in the current project.

decision_mapping.PASS: Keep continuity implementation as the next workstream; separately design a paired baseline test before any efficiency claim.
decision_mapping.PARTIAL: Keep the contract but fix the named traceability/recovery gap before UI or DeepSeek expansion.
decision_mapping.NO-GO: Stop real-provider expansion and repair permission, persistence, or recovery boundaries first.

observed_facts: 3/3 real local task receipts passed the frozen structural traceability rubric.
Recovery smoke final status was succeeded; segment_count=2, snapshot_count=1, resume_count=1.
unknowns: Manual edit count, paired baseline time, cost, and user willingness were not measured by this gate.
Provider model quality and DeepSeek parity remain untested.

verdict.supported_claim_after_run: Narrow real-input traceability and one real-provider same-Run recovery smoke.
unsupported_or_unknown: Manual edit count, paired baseline time, cost, and user willingness were not measured by this gate.

verdict.next_decision: Retain continuity as the next engineering path and design a separate paired baseline before claiming productivity improvement.
